NO_FOLDER_SELECTED_YET: Ba a zaɓi babban fayil (folder) ba tukuna
TOGGLE_STORAGE_LOCATION_DETAILS: Nuna ko ɓoye cikakkun bayanai game da wurin ajiya
HELP_FUND_DEVELOPMENT: Taimaka wajen samar da kuɗin ci gaba da aikin
SELECT_FOLDER_TO_START_ANALYSIS: Zaɓi babban fayil don fara nazarin.
TELEMETRY_STORAGE_DESCRIPTION: Ana nazari da kuma nuna fayilolin CSV da ke cikin wannan shugabanci ta atomatik a kan allon bayanan taƙaitawa (dashboard). Aikin daidaitawa (sync) kai tsaye na USB yana kwafin zaman tafiyar da aka kammala daga wayarka da aka haɗa zuwa wannan wurin.
NO_FOLDER_SELECTED: Ba a zaɓi babban fayil ba
IMPORT_TELEMETRY_FOLDER: Shigo da babban fayil na telemetry
GPS_UNAVAILABLE_SESSIONS_NOTICE: Ba a yi rikodin bayanan GPS ba don waɗannan zaman tafiye-tafiyen, ko kuma bayanan wurin (coordinates) ba su da inganci. Har yanzu ana iya ganin jadawalin bayanan telemetry ɗinka.
IMPORT_TELEMETRY_DESCRIPTION: Shigo da fayilolin bayanan tafiya (telemetry) na CSV domin nazarin aiki, batir, da yanayin zafi.
SELECT_DONATION_PLATFORM: Zaɓi hanyar bayar da gudummawa don tallafawa ci gaba da kula da aikin.
RIDE_MAP_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTION: Taswirar tafiya. Ja don motsawa, yi amfani da maɓallan ƙara da rage girma (zoom), ko maɓallan kibiya.
SAMPLE_VALUES_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTION: Bayanan aiki (telemetry) na samfurin da ake dubawa
RECORDED_RIDE_ROUTE: Hanyar tafiyar da aka yi rikodin
CHOOSE_SAMPLE_INSTRUCTION: Zaɓi wani wuri a kan hanyar ko amfani da maɓallin zamewa (slider).
MAP_BACKGROUND_DESCRIPTION: Taswirar baya tana amfani da sassan taswira na yanar gizo na OpenStreetMap.
HOVER_BLUE_ROUTE_INSTRUCTION: Sanya siginan linzami (cursor) kan layin tafiya mai launin shuɗi don duba samfurin bayanai.
CHOOSE_IMPORT_SOURCE_INSTRUCTION: Zaɓi babban fayil (folder) a wannan kwamfutar ko kuma a daidaita bayanan tafiye-tafiyen da aka kammala daga wayarka.
INSPECT_ASSIST_LEVEL_INSTRUCTION: Sanya siginan linzami kan mataki don duba samfurinsa na farko; yi amfani da ma'aunin zamewa (slider) don bincika cikakken bayanin tafiyar.
ESTIMATED_FROM_REPORTED_CHARGE: an yi kiyasi bisa matakin cajin baturi da aka nuna
ACROSS_SELECTION: a cikin zaɓin da aka yi
BATTERY_USED: Adadin wutar baturi da aka yi amfani da shi
BATTERY_PROVENANCE_NOTICE: Bisa matakan cajin baturi da aka nuna, ba bisa ainihin auna makamashin wuta ba. Ba a haɗa da yawan wutar baturin da aka yi amfani da shi amma ba a rubuta bayaninsa ba.
NO_SESSIONS_MATCH_FILTER: Babu bayanan tafiya (telemetry) da suka dace da matatar (filter) da aka zaɓa.
FOLDER_READY_FOR_SYNC: Babban fayil ɗin a shirye yake. Daidaita wayarka don ƙara bayanan tafiye-tafiyen da aka kammala.
CHOOSE_FOLDER_TO_ENABLE_SYNC: Zaɓi babban fayil ɗin CSV da ke sama don kunna aikin daidaitawa da waya.
SYNC_PHONE_WHEN_CONNECTED: Daidaita wannan wayar idan an haɗa ta
ACTIVE_STORAGE_FOLDER: Babban fayil ɗin ajiya mai aiki
SYNC_NEEDS_ATTENTION: An kammala daidaitawa tare da abubuwan da ke buƙatar kulawa
SYNC_FILES_READY_NOTICE: Fayilolin da aka kammala suna shirye don nazari. Ba a goge ko ɗaya daga cikin fayilolin ba.
SELECT_CONNECTED_PHONE_INSTRUCTION: Zaɓi wayar da aka haɗa. Buɗe kulle ta kuma zaɓi "File transfer" (canja wurin fayil) idan ba ta bayyana a jerin ba.
PHONE_DETECTED_INSTRUCTION: An gano waya. Fara daidaitawa don duba wurin ajiya da kuma shigo da zaman (sessions) da aka kammala.
NO_PHONE_DETECTED_INSTRUCTION: Babu waya da aka gano. Haɗa kebul na USB mai iya bayanai, buɗe wayar kuma zaɓi Canja wurin fayil.
DIRECT_USB_SYNC_WINDOWS_ONLY: Akwai daidaitawar USB kai tsaye akan Windows.
GPS_UNAVAILABLE_SELECTION_NOTICE: Ba a rubuta bayanan GPS na wannan zaɓi ba, ko kuma babu ingantattun ma’aunan wurare biyu da ake buƙata.
GPS_STRAIGHT_CONNECTION_NOTICE: Madaidaicin haɗin kai tsakanin matsayi na GPS da aka rubuta ba sa gano ainihin hanyar.
INSPECT_CHART_OR_ROUTE_INSTRUCTION: Matsar da linzamin kwamfuta a kan ginshiƙi ko blue hanya don duba samfurin. Yi amfani da darjewa don zaɓar wurare masu haɗuwa da GPS.
MAP_BACKGROUND_UNAVAILABLE_NOTICE: Babu bangon taswira ko bai cika ba. Hanyar GPS da samfurin dubawa har yanzu suna aiki.
MAP_ONLINE_PRIVACY_NOTICE: Sassan taswira na intanet: OpenStreetMap yana karɓar adireshinka na IP da yankin taswirar da kake kallo. Samfuran GPS suna nan a wannan kwamfutar.
MAP_BACKGROUND_OFF_NOTICE: An kashe bangon taswirar intanet. Hanyar GPS da duba samfura suna aiki a wannan kwamfutar.
GPS_POSITION_ESTIMATED_NOTICE: Matsayin GPS da aka kiyasta zai cike ɗan gajeren rata a cikin hanyar da aka yi rikodi.
GPS_POSITION_UNAVAILABLE_NOTICE: Babu matsayin GPS don wannan samfurin.
RECORDED_GPS_POSITION: Matsayin GPS da aka yi rikodin
FULL_SCREEN_UNAVAILABLE: Babu cikakken allo a wannan taga.
SYNC_DESTINATION_CHANGE_BLOCKED: Jira aiki tare na yanzu ko soke shi kafin canza wurin.
SYNC_ALREADY_RUNNING: Ana gudanar da daidaitawa a yanzu.
SELECT_DESTINATION_FOLDER_FIRST: Da farko zaɓi babban fayil na karɓar bayanai.
SELECTED_PHONE_DISCONNECTED: Wayar da aka zaɓa ba ta haɗa.
EXTERNAL_URL_NOT_ALLOWED: Ba a yarda da URL na waje ba.
SAVED_TELEMETRY_PATH_NOT_FOLDER: Ajiyayyen hanyar telemetry ba babban fayil ba ne.
INVALID_COMPLETION_MANIFEST: Bayanin kammalawa mara tallafi ko mara inganci.
CSV_EXCEEDS_MANIFEST_SIZE: CSV ya fi girman da bayanin kammalawarsa ya ƙayyade.
CSV_ROW_TOO_LONG: CSV jere yayi tsayi da yawa.
CSV_HEADER_UNSUPPORTED: Ba a tallafa wa kanun CSV ba.
CSV_INTEGRITY_FAILED_NOTICE: Tabbatar da amincin CSV ya gaza. An ajiye kwafin da bai cika ba.
PHONE_DISCONNECTED_WINDOWS_INSTRUCTION: Wayar da aka zaɓa ba ta haɗa da Windows. Duba kebul na USB, buše wayar, kuma zaɓi Canja wurin fayil / Android Auto.
CHOOSE_DESTINATION_FOLDER_FIRST: Da farko zaɓi babban fayil na karɓar bayanai.
DUPLICATE_MANIFEST_FILENAME: Akwai sunan fayil ɗin jerin bayanan kammalawa da aka maimaita a wayar.
DUPLICATE_SESSION_IDENTITY: Akwai shaidar zama da aka maimaita a wayar.
SYNC_STAGING_REQUIRES_DIRECTORY: Dole ne babban fayil na shirya daidaitawa ya kasance ainihin kundin fayiloli.
DIRECT_PHONE_SYNC_WINDOWS_INSTRUCTION: Daidaitawar wayar kai tsaye a halin yanzu yana buƙatar Windows. Har yanzu kuna iya zaɓar babban fayil na fayilolin CSV akan wannan kwamfutar.
TOO_MANY_PORTABLE_DEVICES: Na’urori masu ɗaukuwa sun yi yawa
TOO_MANY_FOLDER_OBJECTS: Abubuwa da yawa a cikin wannan babban fayil
PHONE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE_INSTRUCTION: Babu ma'ajiyar waya. Buɗe wayar kuma zaɓi Canja wurin fayil.
PHONE_PTP_MODE_INSTRUCTION: Wayar tana amfani da Canja wurin Hoto (PTP), wanda ke fallasa hotuna kawai. A waya zaɓi yanayin USB Canja wurin fayil / Android Auto, ajiye ta a buɗe, sannan jira ma'ajiyar ciki ta bayyana a cikin Windows. Sannan sake kunna Sync.
EXPECTED_DEVICE_COMMAND: Ana tsammanin umarnin devices, list ko read
FILTER_SELECTION_SUMMARY: Zaman da aka zaɓa: {count} · {distance} km · minti {duration}
REPORTED_CHARGE_OVER_TIME: Matakin cajin batir da aka ruwaito bisa lokaci
BATTERY_CHARGE_TIME_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRI: Kason cajin batir bisa lokacin da ya wuce cikin zama
BATTERY_PERCENTAGE_POINTS_NOTICE: pp = maki na kaso; jimilla na iya wuce 100. Cajin batir tsakanin zama ba ya shafar jimillar.
BATTERY_EXCLUDED_CHARGE_INCREASE: {exclusion} Cajin baturi ya karu yayin zaman (watakila saboda caji ko karatun ma'aunin baturi yana murmurewa).
BATTERY_EXCLUDED_INVALID_READINGS: {exclusion} Bacewa, mara inganci ko rashin isasshen karatun baturi.
BATTERY_REMAINING_RANGE_SUMMARY: Cajin ƙarshe da aka ruwaito {chargeValue} · kiyasin nisan tafiya {rangeValue}
BATTERY_DISCHARGE_REQUIREMENTS: Jadawalin saukar cajin batir yana buƙatar raguwar aƙalla {minimum} pp, ingantattun lokutan da aka rubuta, da rashin ƙaruwa a caji.
AVERAGE_ASSISTED_MOTOR_POWER: Matsakaicin ƙarfin motar da aka taimaka: {power} W.
RIDE_PROFILE_SUMMARY: Matsakaicin saurin gudu yayin motsi {speed} km/h · mafi girman zafin jiki {temperature} °C.
PHONE_SYNC_SETUP_INSTRUCTION: Haɗa kuma buɗe wayarka, sannan zaɓi {transferMode}. Ana ƙara zaman da suka kammala a babban fayil na CSV da aka zaɓa a sama. Idan Windows ya nuna {dcim} da {pictures} kaɗai, wayar tana yanayin canja wurin hoto (PTP) kuma ba a samun fayilolin telemetry.
SYNC_CANCELLING_NOTICE: Ana sokewa… Za a adana kwafin da suka kammala.
GPS_SESSIONS_WITHOUT_COORDINATES: Zaman da ba su da ingantattun ma’aunan GPS da aka rubuta (har da tsofaffin fayilolin CSV): {missing} cikin {total}.
GPS_BRIDGED_GAPS_SUMMARY: Gajerun gibba da aka haɗa: {count}. Wuraren da aka ƙiyasta da aka yi amfani da su: {positions}.
GPS_DISCONNECTED_GAPS_SUMMARY: Dogayen gibba ko tsalle-tsallen wurare marasa ma’ana da ba a haɗa ba: {count}.
GPS_SAMPLES_WITHOUT_POSITION: Samfura ba tare da matsayi mai sake ginawa ba: {count}.
OPEN_IMPORT_DATA_INSTRUCTION: Buɗe {importData} don zaɓar babban fayil ko daidaita wayarka.
TELEMETRY_FOLDER_DIALOG_TITLE: A ina ya kamata a adana fayilolin CSV na telemetry akan wannan kwamfutar?
NOT_REGULAR_FILE: Ba fayil na yau da kullun ba: {name}
FILE_CONTENT_CONFLICT: Rikici: {name} ya riga ya wanzu tare da abun ciki daban-daban.
FILE_ADD_UNSAFE_NOTICE: Ba za a iya ƙara wannan fayil ɗin lafiya ba ({code}). Zaɓi babban fayil na gida mai goyan bayan hanyoyin haɗin kai, kamar NTFS.
DESTINATION_CONTENT_CHANGED: {name}: manufa ta bayyana da abun ciki daban-daban yayin kwafin.
SYNC_CANCELLED_NOTICE: An soke sync. An adana cikakkun kwafi.
PHONE_STOPPED_RESPONDING: Wayar ta daina amsawa. Duba haɗin USB.
USB_COPY_INTERRUPTED: An katse kwafin USB. Duba haɗin wayar.
PHONE_TELEMETRY_FOLDER_NOT_FOUND: Download/ApexDrive/Telemetry ba a samo shi ba. Kammala hawa kuma buɗe ApexDrive don buga ajiyayyun zaman. Ma'ajiyar waya mai gani: {storage}
SYNC_RESULT_SUMMARY: {status} — Zaman da aka ƙara: {added}; waɗanda suke akwai: {present}; waɗanda suke jira: {pending}.
SYNC_RETAINED_BYTES_NOTICE: An ajiye {size} don farfadowa. Ba a share fayiloli ba.
EXAMPLE_TELEMETRY_DESCRIPTION: Bincika tafiyar da aka haɗa ba tare da zaɓar babban fayil ba. Ana ware bayanan misali daga zaman ka.
EXAMPLE_TELEMETRY_NOTICE: Kana kallon tafiyar misali. Ba a haɗa ta a jimillar zaman ka na sirri ba.
